items.html: Now, Yeshsut is made from the lower half of the Bina of MA, and Tevuna is made from the complete Bina of BON. Then both are in the phase of the Bina of MA and BON, and are therefore both called simply Bina. This is the first Hey of the Name. Then Aba is hidden and concealed, for he too is the Yod of the filling of Yod-Hey, since now she has no advantage over him — for now both are of the phase of Bina, and since he is of the male phase, he prevails over her. This is unlike AVI, where Ima has a very great advantage over Aba, as above.
